# NEW 2026-11-23 v19.0 Module 19.0-D: AI 3.0 Yearly Hook & Non-Cheating Strategic Responsiveness (CMDLOG=0) (oe_ai3_, 0 mainline slots, 0 rules, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v190_ai3_tests.py; edit the generator, not this file.
# Exports ONE O(1) zero-slot yearly hook: `oe_ai3_kernel_yearly = yes`.
# Self-deduplicated via `global_var:oe_ai3_ran_y ?= current_year`.
# Strictly non-cheating: adapts AI 3.0 personalities & dispatches balanced strategic events
# (oe_ai3.1..8) with realistic diplomatic/fiscal trade-offs and zero free troops or gold.

# Global scope. Main exported yearly hook for Stage Integrator / oe_gk_yearly_dispatch.
oe_ai3_kernel_yearly = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { global_var:oe_ai3_ran_y ?= current_year } }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_ai3_ran_y value = current_year }

		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ai3_init } }
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_ai3_init value = 1 }
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_ai3_yearly_ticks value = 0 }
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_ai3_coalition_alerts value = 0 }
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_ai3_catchup_waves value = 0 }
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_ai3_naval_races value = 0 }
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_ai3_realignments value = 0 }
		}
		change_global_variable = { name = oe_ai3_yearly_ticks add = 1 }

		# 1. Non-cheating AI 3.0 strategic personality synchronization (strictly yields to austerity)
		if = {
			limit = { oe_ai3_active_guard = yes }
			oe_ai3_sync_personalities = yes
		}

		# 2. Great Power coalition, industrial catch-up, naval arms & corridor event dispatcher
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_game_rule = oe_rule_hegemon_ai_off } }
			oe_ai3_evaluate_strategic_pulses = yes
		}
	}
}

# Global scope. Synchronize the 4 next-gen AI 3.0 personalities on qualifying Great Powers & poles.
oe_ai3_sync_personalities = {
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			oe_ai3_ai_healthy_base = yes
			OR = {
				is_great_power = yes
				num_locations >= 30
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { oe_ai3_is_industrial_modernizer_fit = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { ai_personality != ai_personality:oe_ai3_industrial_modernizer }
				set_personality = ai_personality:oe_ai3_industrial_modernizer
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { oe_ai3_is_balance_arbiter_fit = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { ai_personality != ai_personality:oe_ai3_balance_of_power_arbiter }
				set_personality = ai_personality:oe_ai3_balance_of_power_arbiter
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { oe_ai3_is_maritime_thalassocrat_fit = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { ai_personality != ai_personality:oe_ai3_maritime_thalassocrat }
				set_personality = ai_personality:oe_ai3_maritime_thalassocrat
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { oe_ai3_is_silk_road_unifier_fit = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { ai_personality != ai_personality:oe_ai3_silk_road_unifier }
				set_personality = ai_personality:oe_ai3_silk_road_unifier
			}
		}
	}
}

# Global scope. Evaluates strategic conditions once per year and dispatches visible events oe_ai3.1..8
# with long per-country cooldowns so every event is reachable (0 orphans) and never spams.
oe_ai3_evaluate_strategic_pulses = {
	# Event 1: Great Power Diplomatic Realignment (1420+)
	if = {
		limit = { current_year >= 1420 }
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				oe_ai3_is_great_power_actor = yes
				num_rivals >= 2
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_ai3_cd_1 }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_ai3_cd_1 value = 1 days = 9125 }
			change_global_variable = { name = oe_ai3_realignments add = 1 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_ai3.1 }
		}
	}

	# Event 2: Balance-of-Power Counter-Coalition (1410+, when an overmighty hegemon emerges)
	if = {
		limit = {
			current_year >= 1410
			oe_ai3_has_hegemon_threat = yes
		}
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				oe_ai3_is_great_power_actor = yes
				is_hegemon = no
				num_locations < 140
				any_rival = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					OR = {
						is_hegemon = yes
						num_locations >= 140
					}
				}
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_ai3_cd_2 }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_ai3_cd_2 value = 1 days = 9125 }
			change_global_variable = { name = oe_ai3_coalition_alerts add = 1 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_ai3.2 }
		}
	}

	# Event 3: Industrial Catch-Up Charter (1660+, neighbor has Manufactories)
	if = {
		limit = { current_year >= 1660 }
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				oe_main_mod_global_event_allowed = yes
				oe_ai3_needs_industrial_catchup = yes
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_ai3_cd_3 }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_ai3_cd_3 value = 1 days = 10950 }
			change_global_variable = { name = oe_ai3_catchup_waves add = 1 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_ai3.3 }
		}
	}

	# Event 4: Oceanic Naval Arms Race (1480+, rival maritime fleets)
	if = {
		limit = { current_year >= 1480 }
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				oe_main_mod_global_event_allowed = yes
				oe_ai3_is_naval_arms_contender = yes
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_ai3_cd_4 }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_ai3_cd_4 value = 1 days = 9125 }
			change_global_variable = { name = oe_ai3_naval_races add = 1 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_ai3.4 }
		}
	}

	# Event 5: Chancellery Cipher & Intelligence Audit (1500+, rivalrous Great Power)
	if = {
		limit = { current_year >= 1500 }
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				oe_ai3_is_great_power_actor = yes
				num_rivals >= 1
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_ai3_cd_5 }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_ai3_cd_5 value = 1 days = 10950 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_ai3.5 }
		}
	}

	# Event 6: Continental Silk Road Caravan Compact (1400+, overland Eurasian corridor power)
	if = {
		limit = { current_year >= 1400 }
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				oe_main_mod_old_world_event_allowed = yes
				is_subject = no
				num_locations >= 25
				OR = {
					has_presence_in = region:persia_region
					has_presence_in = region:khorasan_region
					has_presence_in = region:xinjiang_region
					has_presence_in = region:anatolia_region
					has_presence_in = region:north_china_region
				}
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_ai3_cd_6 }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_ai3_cd_6 value = 1 days = 10950 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_ai3.6 }
		}
	}

	# Event 7: Thalassocratic Strait & Canal Council (1450+, canal or maritime empire)
	if = {
		limit = { current_year >= 1450 }
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				oe_main_mod_global_event_allowed = yes
				is_subject = no
				OR = {
					owns = location:suez
					owns = location:panama
					owns = location:kiel
					owns = location:corinth
					owns = location:yangzhou
					owns = location:hangzhou
					AND = {
						num_of_ports >= 10
						navy_size >= 30
					}
				}
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_ai3_cd_7 }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_ai3_cd_7 value = 1 days = 10950 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_ai3.7 }
		}
	}

	# Event 8: Concert of Eurasia Strategic Assessment (1648+, multipolar Great Power summit)
	if = {
		limit = { current_year >= 1648 }
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				oe_ai3_is_great_power_actor = yes
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_ai3_cd_8 }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_ai3_cd_8 value = 1 days = 10950 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_ai3.8 }
		}
	}
}
